skills.name: ml4t-run-backtest
skills.required_invariants: Use Strategy, DataFeed, Engine, next-bar fills, and explicit costs.
skills.verification: Native ledgers contain stop and market fills; daily Sharpe uses ml4t.backtest.analytics.

skills.name: ml4t-polars-patterns
skills.required_invariants: Use sorted Polars operations and lazy scans for large data.
skills.verification: Source files are scanned lazily; grouped bar and rolling-level operations are Polars expressions.

skills.name: ml4t-validate-data
skills.required_invariants: Check OHLC consistency, duplicates, nulls, finite values, timestamps, and gaps.
skills.verification: source_quality.json reports these checks and source/calendar gaps.

skills.name: ml4t-build-bars
skills.required_invariants: Keep intervals explicit and do not treat partial bars as complete.
skills.verification: Only bins with 30 distinct minute timestamps are retained; a DST regression test checks 50 elapsed bars.

skills.name: ml4t-calendar-ops
skills.reason_selected: Align entries with the Chicago session and provider calendar
skills.required_invariants: Use the correct timezone, DST behavior, and qualified trading sessions.
skills.verification: Session starts use America/Chicago then elapsed UTC intervals; qualification and calendar identity hashes pass.

skills.name: ml4t-lookahead-bias
skills.reason_selected: Prevent future bar data from setting stop levels
skills.required_invariants: Use only previous complete bars and submit orders for a future engine event.
skills.verification: The 50-bar test verifies prior-bar extrema; native execution uses NEXT_BAR.

skills.name: ml4t-cost-model
skills.reason_selected: Compare the declared zero-cost and cost-aware cases
skills.required_invariants: Apply costs per fill and disclose unsupported market-specific assumptions.
skills.verification: Fills record commission and slippage; the cost-aware assumption is explicitly illustrative.

skills.name: ml4t-continuous-futures
skills.reason_selected: Prevent a CFD proxy from being described as CME futures
skills.required_invariants: Verify contract and roll identity before making futures claims.
skills.verification: The report identifies a Dukascopy CFD proxy and makes no NQ roll or product-economics claim.
